verdict.rationale: Pylon's own agents can pull context beyond help articles. Connectors let agents "retrieve information" from external tools, admins can define Custom API tools that hit internal endpoints, and the Assist Agent works from account context already in Pylon. The docs never explicitly show customer-facing answers grounded in a specific customer's plan, order status or account history. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Support Agent replies are personalized with per-customer live data (plan, order status, history), concrete examples of the product-data sync feeding agent answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, answers use the customer's live data — plan, order status, account history — not just generic help articles

citations.quote: Connectors give Pylon agents access to external tools so they can search for context, retrieve information, and take action outside Pylon.
an administrator can define a Custom API tool that agents can use to hit internal or third party API endpoints.
Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
